label: r0
issues: Does not read as a falcon/eagle at a glance; looks like an abstract robot/lamp
Beak is a long thin yellow bar/antenna sticking straight out instead of a short hooked yellow beak
Wings are small grey/brown plates jutting sideways rather than large brown folded wings with dark grey tips
No tail; the concept's long brown/grey tail is entirely missing
Body is a loose stack of exposed studs and gaps, not a smooth sculpted chest
White/brown colour blocking inverted and patchy; brown appears on the chest and white on the body sides
Talons/yellow feet barely visible, no gripping claws on the perch
Perch branch missing; only a short brown stub above the tan base
Head lacks the white crown and dark grey eye-stripe shaping
Exposed studs and messy geometry read as unfinished, not an official set
distilled: A LEGO model of a chunky stylised falcon perched on a short branch base, built from stacked bricks and plates with wedge-plate wings folded at its sides and a curved slope head.
